title: Canonical compositor squares preserve iterated module unit sections
statement: For any commutative ring B and any commutative square a ≫ j = j′ ≫ g of schemes, the canonical inverse-image compositor square sends the two iterated module-adjunction unit sections to one another after restriction along the inverse projection-preserving site-square isomorphism. The precise directions, test object and section are the displayed Lean statement. This uses the canonical operations of [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations] and [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with no open-immersion hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 04J0, localization of morphisms of ringed sites; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A7, adjunction base-change construction. The explicit unit-section equation is agent-formulated from canonical conjugate compositors.

proof.text: Conjugate the inverse-image square under the two composite module adjunctions. The compositor definition identifies its conjugate with the upper direct-image compositor, equality transport, and the inverse lower compositor. Apply the conjugate unit identity and evaluate at a section. Each direct-image compositor is restriction along the canonical fibre-product pasting isomorphism. Functoriality combines the three restrictions into the inverse site square, proving the formula.

lean.statement:
theorem towerSquare_unit_sections {U' U X' X : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : U' ⟶ U) (j' : U' ⟶ X') (j : U ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (w : a ≫ j = j' ≫ g) (M : Modules B X) (V : X.ProEt)
    (m : M.val.obj (op V)) :
    ((moduleSquareG B a j' j g w).inv.app M).val.app
      (op ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange a).obj ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange j).obj V)))
      (towerUnitSection B a ((modulePullback B j).obj M)
        ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange j).obj V) (towerUnitSection B j M V m)) =
    ((modulePullback B j').obj ((modulePullback B g).obj M)).val.map
      ((towerSiteSquare a j' j g w).inv.app V).op
      (towerUnitSection B j' ((modulePullback B g).obj M)
        ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V) (towerUnitSection B g M V m))
